title: solanum pentlandii subsp. interandinum
intro: Solanum pentlandii subsp. interandinum, commonly known as the Andean nightshade, is a plant species belonging to the Solanaceae family. The Andean nightshade has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including pain, inflammation, and fever, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as glycoalkaloids and phenolic compounds. The bioactive constituents of Solanum pentlandii subsp. interandinum have been reported to possess antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its medicinal properties.
